# Parse the archive songs from the file content
archive_content = archive_file['content']
archive_songs = []
for line in archive_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Format: "Title by Artist"
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            archive_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(archive_songs)
